route.shell: masthead + guide rail (>=1024 only) + filter chip bar + rich grid, dark theme

viewports.searchAffordance: inline search field (515px) + submit button + voice button

states.name: loading
states.trigger: feed request in flight after a client-side refresh (chip change, reload)
states.userSees: shell retained (masthead, guide, chip bar); grid replaced by skeleton tiles: 16:9 block, 36px avatar circle, two text bars; centred indeterminate spinner below the grid; no text, no error copy

states.name: ready
states.trigger: feed resolved with at least one item
states.userSees: filter chips with one selected; card grid (3/2/1 columns); cards with thumbnail + duration badge + title + channel avatar/name + view/age metadata + overflow action; horizontal shelves further down; promoted tiles may occupy a grid cell

states.name: empty
states.trigger: signed-out visitor with no local activity (fresh profile)
states.userSees: authored panel replacing the grid: short heading + one sentence inviting search/watch activity; centred; elevated surface; no chip bar; shell retained
states.recovery: search or watch a video (the panel's own invitation)

states.name: error
states.trigger: feed request fails (browse/guide/next blocked on a cold profile)
states.userSees: skeleton tiles first (0-4s), then the same authored panel as the empty state; no error copy, no alert, no retry affordance at 4s or 12s
states.recovery: none offered in the surface; empty-state invitation only

states.name: offline (cold)
states.trigger: navigation attempted with no network before the app is cached
states.userSees: browser-owned network error page (document is not the app); connection troubleshooting copy and an error code

states.name: offline (warm)
states.trigger: network lost after the feed rendered
states.userSees: no visual change and no alert when a feed action is attempted; previously rendered cards remain

states.name: disabled
states.userSees: no create or notifications controls; account area is a sign-in call to action; guide holds only the public destinations; card actions that need an account are still listed in the menu

controls.name: guide toggle
controls.behaviour: toggles the guide rail between the 72px mini rail and a 240px drawer; drawer reaches full width in ~0.4s

controls.name: skip navigation
controls.behaviour: present off-screen until focused; third stop in the desktop tab order; jumps past the shell

controls.name: search field
controls.behaviour: at >=656px an inline field; pressing / moves focus into it; absent at 390 where an icon button opens search

controls.name: sign-in entry
controls.behaviour: out of scope: not followed (no auth attempts)

controls.name: guide destinations
controls.behaviour: four public destinations in the signed-out rail (home, short-form, subscriptions, account); each is 56px tall with icon + label

controls.name: filter chips
controls.behaviour: one selected chip; selecting another replaces the feed in place without a route change; first content change ~0.12s, settled ~0.9-1.9s; rail scrolls horizontally and scrolls itself when focus moves

controls.name: video card
controls.behaviour: thumbnail and title are one link target to the watch route; the card also carries an overflow button

controls.name: card overflow menu
controls.behaviour: opens a menu of three account-adjacent actions (queue, playlist, share) in ~30-40ms; Escape closes it in ~50ms and returns focus to the trigger

controls.name: infinite scroll
controls.behaviour: reaching the end appends more cards and grows the document; first growth ~0.56-0.87s; the grid is virtualised (earlier cards are recycled), so item counts in the DOM are not monotonic

timingsMeta.method: PerformanceNavigationTiming/Paint/LCP/CLS/long-task entries captured in-page; interaction latency measured from input dispatch to observed DOM/visual change on one machine and network

a11y.visibleFocus: white rounded focus indicator on the focused control (screenshot kbd-01)
a11y.labels: all measured controls expose an accessible name; chips are named by their visible text
a11y.reducedMotion: no running CSS animations were reported and the probed chip transition is 0s, before and under prefers-reduced-motion; there is little for the preference to suppress, and the inline preview's own motion could not be observed

masthead.note: field box is the input element; the surrounding pill is ~40px tall

chip.labelNote: label typography was not captured (the host element reports inherited 10px; the rendered label is larger)
chip.note: corner radius is applied below the probed host element; visually ~8px

shelf.note: horizontal shelf row with its own title, below the first grid rows

emptyPanel.surface: raised surface, lighter than the page background

gaps.question: What changes when signed in (personalised feed, subscriptions, notifications, create)?
gaps.why: Requires an account session; guardrails forbid logged-in state and private endpoints.

gaps.question: Does hovering a card start a muted inline preview, and after what delay?
gaps.why: Not reproduced in 3 dedicated runs (media requests returned 403 in this environment); a single earlier probe saw a playing element at ~0.71s. Cannot state a reliable range.

gaps.question: Is there any authored error message or retry affordance on home at all?
gaps.why: Observed 4s and 12s after a blocked feed request: skeleton then the empty panel, no alert or retry. A longer wait or a different failure class might surface one.

gaps.question: Is the skeleton shown on the very first cold load, or is the feed server-rendered?
gaps.why: Holding the browse XHR paused the feed on a warm reload but no pause occurred on a cold first navigation, which suggests server-rendered initial data.

gaps.question: Does mobile web show a bottom navigation bar?
gaps.why: At 390 with a desktop user agent no bottom bar was rendered; a real phone user agent may differ. Device emulation was not used.

gaps.question: Do chips support arrow-key roving focus inside the tablist?
gaps.why: Only Tab and Enter were exercised; the rail scrolls when focus moves but arrow-key behaviour was not measured.

gaps.question: What controls does a horizontal shelf expose (arrows, see-all) and how do they behave?
gaps.why: Shelves were present below the fold; their controls were not exercised.

gaps.question: How much of a promoted grid tile differs from a normal card?
gaps.why: Promoted tiles appeared in several runs with a sponsor line and two call-to-action buttons; ad inventory is not reproducible on demand.

gaps.question: Exact background colour and type scale of the empty panel
gaps.why: The panel is rendered by a component the card-oriented style probe did not target; geometry is measured from the snapshot, colour/type are read from the screenshot.

gaps.question: Which parts of the surface depend on region, language or experiment assignment?
gaps.why: One region and one locale were observed; chip taxonomy and promoted content are assignment-dependent.

gaps.question: What happens when a signed-out user activates queue/playlist/save actions?
gaps.why: Not followed: it leads to an auth surface the guardrails exclude.
